{{Short description|American mathematician}}

'''Lewis Bowen''' is an American mathematician and professor at [[The University of Texas at Austin]], where he holds the Jane and Roland Blumberg Centennial Professorship in Mathematics as of 2025. His research focuses on [[ergodic theory]], [[probability theory]], and [[dynamical systems]], with particular emphasis on the ergodic theory of non-amenable group actions and [[geometric group theory]].

== Education ==
Bowen earned both his [[bachelor's degree]] (1997) and [[Ph.D.]] (2002) from [[The University of Texas at Austin]]. His Ph.D. was supervised by [[Charles Radin]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|60210}}</ref>

== Career ==
Before returning to UT Austin in 2012, Bowen held academic positions at several institutions including the [[University of Hawaiʻi]], [[Texas A&M University]], and [[Indiana University]].

== Research ==
Bowen's research interests include:
* [[Ergodic theory]]
* [[Probability theory]]
* [[Dynamical systems]]
* Ergodic theory of non-amenable group actions
* [[Geometric group theory]]

== Honors and recognition ==
* Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] (inaugural class, 2012)<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ams.org/cgi-bin/fellows/fellows.cgi#m |title=Fellows of the American Mathematical Society |publisher=American Mathematical Society |access-date=December 15, 2024}}</ref>
* [[Michael Brin Prize in Dynamical Systems]] (2017) for his "fundamental contributions to measurable and topological dynamics, particularly for non-amenable group actions, invariant random subgroups, and entropy theory"<ref>{{cite journal |url=https://www.aimsciences.org/article/doi/10.3934/jmd.2019015?viewType=HTML |title=The work of Lewis Bowen on the entropy theory of non-amenable group actions |publisher=AIMS Sciences |journal=Journal of Modern Dynamics |doi=10.3934/jmd.2019015 |access-date=December 15, 2024|doi-access=free }}</ref>
* Invited speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] (2018, [[Rio de Janeiro]])<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J8YtfE2S1yI |title=Lewis Bowen - ICM 2018 Invited Address |date=17 October 2018 |publisher=YouTube |access-date=December 15, 2024}}</ref>
